mapper.select: SELECT term_id, term_code, term_name, content, version, kakao_tag, required, active, effective_at, created_at, updated_at FROM terms WHERE active = TRUE AND ( effective_at IS NULL OR effective_at <= NOW() ) ORDER BY term_id ASC

SELECT term_id, term_code, term_name, content, version, kakao_tag, required, active, effective_at, created_at, updated_at FROM terms WHERE active = TRUE AND required = TRUE AND ( effective_at IS NULL OR effective_at <= NOW() ) ORDER BY term_id ASC
SELECT term_id, term_code, term_name, content, version, kakao_tag, required, active, effective_at, created_at, updated_at FROM terms ORDER BY term_code ASC, created_at DESC, term_id DESC

SELECT term_id, term_code, term_name, content, version, kakao_tag, required, active, effective_at, created_at, updated_at FROM terms FORCE INDEX (uq_terms_code_version) WHERE term_code = #{termCode} ORDER BY version ASC, term_id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT term_id, term_code, term_name, content, version, kakao_tag, required, active, effective_at, created_at, updated_at FROM terms WHERE term_id = #{termId}

SELECT term_id, term_code, term_name, content, version, kakao_tag, required, active, effective_at, created_at, updated_at FROM terms WHERE term_code = #{termCode} AND active = TRUE AND ( effective_at IS NULL OR effective_at <= NOW() ) ORDER BY effective_at DESC, term_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT term_id, term_code, term_name, content, version, kakao_tag, required, active, effective_at, created_at, updated_at FROM terms WHERE term_code = #{termCode} AND version = #{version} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO terms ( term_code, term_name, content, version, kakao_tag, required, active, effective_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{termCode}, #{termName}, #{content}, #{version}, #{kakaoTag}, #{required}, #{active}, #{effectiveAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE terms SET active = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE term_code = #{termCode} AND active = TRUE
